positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge does the organization direct to be erased, and what does that erasure command enact?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding the removal of specific, named knowledge artifacts — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, its helium procurement contracts, and zeppelin routes. They share a single directional read: flat, matter-of-fact register performing authority-ranking erasure, in present-tense irrealis demanding a future state-change. The conviction is settled decision on both, not argued or floated. The set coheres as one read: what the organization has decided must no longer be known, performed as bare hierarchical command without negotiation.
